snippet.title: Knightica - Official Release Date Trailer | Autobattler Roguelike Indie Game
snippet.description:
Try the new demo for Knightica today: https://linktr.ee/Knightica

Knightica is a new autobattler roguelike developed by Mad Mango Games and published by Goblinz Publishing.

Enroll units of all shapes and sizes.
Place and rotate your troops to make the most of their unique abilities.
Upgrade your army, search for the perfect ally, or focus on your economy.
Lead your troops through increasingly challenging worlds.

Knightica will be available on PC and consoles on August 21st, 2025!
